description_for_human: Read-only governance data for every AI agent in your Microsoft 365 tenant.
description_for_model: Reads live, read-only governance data about the AI agents in the signed-in user's Microsoft 365 tenant: the inventory across Copilot Studio, M365 Agent Builder, Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Fabric; Data Loss Prevention posture per environment; aggregate usage joined with real Azure spend; duplicate clusters and a consolidation plan; and a map of the estate. All operations are read-only and never modify the tenant.
